text: Flight Vehicle Design is an undergraduate major offered by ordinary universities in China, belonging to the aerospace category. The code for this major is 082002. The general duration of study is four years and it confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. This major aims to teach basic theories and knowledge in areas such as aerospace science and technology, mechanics, and control science and engineering. It aims to cultivate senior engineering professionals with capabilities in aircraft design, performance calculation and analysis, structural stress and analysis, who can engage in theoretical research, design development, and technical management in the aerospace field.
